title: Magic Product Review - Sucker Punch: Revolutions
description:
Murphy's Magic has added to their original Sucker Punch by Mark Southworth and now added a bunch of new gimmicks, updated the chips look and provides a master class on coin magic done with poker chips. This is a great starter kit for those who are interested in coin magic but don't want to invest the money until they know they can do the routines with confidence and if the gaff is right for them. Watch the entire review to get my perspective. Thanks so much for watching. If you could hit that Like and Subscribe button it would be greatly appreciated.

Fiddle Tune: I can't remember the name of it. 

Thanks to Penguin Magic for providing me with this review copy so I could do this review for you.
